security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real risk in unsafe ZIP archive extraction, selected external converter execution, and privileged or environment-modifying install guidance. Most other static hits are false positives from OOXML namespace URLs, schema references, Markdown formatting, JavaScript template literals, or validation text. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed skill files.

remediation.issue: Unsafe archive extraction in bundled Office document helpers.
remediation.suggestion: Replace every ZipFile.extractall call with safe extraction that rejects absolute paths, parent-directory traversal, symlinks, and oversized entries.

remediation.issue: External converters run on user-provided presentation files.
remediation.suggestion: Run LibreOffice, Poppler, and similar tools inside a sandbox with time, memory, file, and network limits.
Remove sudo commands from agent-facing instructions and document dependencies as manual prerequisites or container image requirements.

remediation.issue: Package installation guidance can modify the user environment.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer pinned dependencies in an isolated virtual environment or container instead of global pip and npm installation commands.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint decks are hard to automate when layouts, notes, and XML details matter. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PPTX creation, editing, validation, and visual review.
actual_capabilities: Creates new PPTX decks from HTML slide layouts with positioned text, images, shapes, charts, and tables.
Unpacks PPTX files for direct Office Open XML editing of slides, layouts, notes, comments, themes, and media.
Rearranges template slides, duplicates selected layouts, and replaces text while preserving paragraph formatting.
Extracts slide text inventories with shape positions, font data, colors, bullets, alignment, and overflow warnings.
Generates thumbnail grids from presentations to support visual review and layout validation.
Validates edited OOXML files against relationship, namespace, content type, and schema checks.
limitations: Requires local Python, Node.js, LibreOffice, Poppler, and related presentation libraries for full workflows.
Direct OOXML edits can corrupt decks if relationship files, content types, or layout references are inconsistent.
Thumbnail and PDF conversion depend on external binaries and may render differently from Microsoft PowerPoint.
The bundled archive extraction helpers need hardening before use with untrusted Office files.

use_cases.title: Build research slide decks
use_cases.description: Create structured scientific or technical presentations from outlines, charts, tables, and visual design requirements.

use_cases.title: Adapt branded templates
use_cases.description: Map new content into an existing PowerPoint template while preserving slide layouts and formatting rules.

use_cases.title: Repair presentation XML
use_cases.description: Inspect raw PPTX files, edit OOXML relationships, and validate package structure after manual changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner deck generation from an outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint deck from this outline. Use a clean visual hierarchy, strong contrast, and speaker notes for each slide.

prompt_templates.title: Use an existing template
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this template, create a slide inventory, choose matching layouts for my content, and produce a new deck that preserves the template style.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a slide safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Targeted modification of an existing PPTX file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Unpack this presentation, update the specified slide text and chart data, validate the OOXML package, and generate thumbnails for review.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose OOXML problems
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting after manual XML changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the unpacked PPTX structure, find broken relationships or content type issues, explain the root cause, and provide a safe repair plan.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a short investor update deck from bullet notes and two metrics.
output: A concise deck outline with title, traction, product, metrics, and next steps slides.
A generated PPTX file with consistent typography, charts, and speaker notes.
A thumbnail grid for visual review before delivery.

output_examples.input: A user provides a branded template and new section content.
output: A template inventory that identifies slide layouts and reusable sections.
A content-to-template mapping that uses only suitable slide designs.
A revised presentation with replaced text and preserved layout formatting.

output_examples.input: A user has a PPTX file that fails to open after manual XML edits.
output: A validation summary covering relationships, content types, namespaces, and schema errors.
A repair checklist that targets the affected XML files.
A repacked deck after the detected structural issues are corrected.

best_practices: Work on a copy of every presentation and keep the original file available for comparison.
Validate after each OOXML edit before making more changes to the package.
Generate thumbnails and inspect text overflow, contrast, alignment, and slide order before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not edit slide XML without updating related relationship and content type files.
Do not force content into template placeholders that do not match the amount or type of content.
Do not process untrusted PPTX files with archive extraction or converters outside a sandbox.

faq.question: Can this skill create a PowerPoint file from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses an HTML-to-PPTX workflow with PptxGenJS for positioned slide content.

faq.question: Can it edit speaker notes and comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to unpack a PPTX file and edit notes, comments, layouts, and related XML parts.

faq.question: Does it require Microsoft PowerPoint?
faq.answer: No. Core workflows use Python, Node.js, OOXML files, LibreOffice, and Poppler instead of PowerPoint automation.

faq.question: Can it preserve a branded template?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inventory template slides, choose suitable layouts, rearrange slides, and replace text carefully.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted PPTX files?
faq.answer: Use caution. Some bundled helpers extract ZIP archives and run external converters, so sandboxing is recommended.

faq.question: Can it validate repaired files?
faq.answer: Yes. The OOXML validation scripts check relationships, namespaces, content types, schema rules, and common package errors.
